Welcome to BiNxNdo 2025, the first speedcubing competition at the oldest Chinatown in the world! This competition features the events 3x3, 4x4, 5x5 6x6, 7x7, and 4x4 Blindfolded with **5x5** as the main event.
​
We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing.
​
This competition is hosted by the **Philippine Cubers Association**.
